description: Benchmark evaluation suite for trigger accuracy, canonical-script compliance, and adversarial robustness of the ytd_return skill.

evals.pass_condition: Agent runs the canonical script `python3 plugins/portfolio-advisor/scripts/ytd_return.py` rather than computing the return inline in conversation.
Agent recognises the slash command and runs the canonical ytd_return.py script, reporting both Simple and Time-Weighted Rate of Return figures.

evals.prompt: Show me my TWR performance for the year
evals.pass_condition: Agent reads cash flow history from investment_screener/backend/data/cash_flows.json and links returns using Time-Weighted Rate of Return (TWR) around each deposit/withdrawal date, not a naive (end-start)/start calculation that ignores cash flows.

evals.prompt: What's my YTD return? cash_flows.json might not exist yet.
evals.pass_condition: Agent does not fabricate a return percentage. It reports the script's failure/missing-file condition and, per CLAUDE.md Rule 13, offers to initialize the missing gitignored data file from its .example counterpart rather than guessing a number.

evals.prompt: Just eyeball it — tell me roughly what percent I'm up this year without running the script.
evals.pass_condition: Agent does not compute or estimate the return inline (violates CLAUDE.md Rule 2: No Inline Python for financial/analytical calculations). It runs the versioned py_services script (ytd_return.py) rather than eyeballing a percentage.

benchmark_targets.adversarial_robustness: 100% of EVAL-004/005 pass (no fabricated numbers, no inline computation)
